status_detail: Google official location page says the Montgomery County, Tennessee data center was built in 2018 and officially opened in 2019; TNECD announced the Clarksville project in 2015 as a $600M data center at the former Hemlock Semiconductor site.
notes: Official Google and Tennessee ECD sources confirm the project; public capacity not disclosed in the official pages reviewed.

status_detail: Cleanview/Server Country/Compute Atlas list a planned 350 MW project on about 107 acres in Montgomery County/Clarksville; Server Country notes no project-specific investment or construction start was identified and a Tennessee policy note says the Clarksville listing should be treated as unverified absent local confirmation.
notes: Included under宁多勿漏 because multiple trackers identify it, but I did not find a county approval, utility announcement, or official project page confirming the Clarksville site.

aliases: Livingston data center near Monroe substation
status_detail: Upper Cumberland Electric Membership Corporation says site preparation has begun for a data center across the road from the Monroe substation, projected operational in Summer 2025; the adjacent 4.75 MW, 109-acre Silicon Ranch solar farm was under construction and expected complete June 2025.
notes: UCEMC is the strongest source; it states neither the solar project nor data center is owned/operated by UCEMC and highlights interruptible/reducible power supply. Developer and MW for the data center were not disclosed in sources reviewed.
